integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained; an exhaustive rational computation for finitely many dimensions provides reproducibility evidence only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to zero-inclusive consecutive-ones polytopes for n>=2; weighted and general connected-block families are not classified. Older equivalent statements under alternative terminology remain possible. No independent external review is asserted.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry and an exceptional center segment for interval-incidence polytopes
